notes.account_number: Printed as "•••• 7421" (bullet-masked). Both BDA and LLM normalized this down to just "7421" - a defensible read, but this fixture uses the as-printed masked form as ground truth, consistent with the identity-proof fixture's convention.
notes.transaction_details.description: As-printed text includes an en-dash before the payee/vendor (e.g. "DÉBITO: Servicios Públicos – Alabama Power"); LLM dropped the dash on two of the six rows.
notes.transaction_details.date: Printed as MM/DD/YYYY ('08/05/2026', etc.); normalized to ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) here, consistent with statement_start_date/statement_end_date and every other date field in this schema. BDA's blueprint (AWS-managed, not ours) instructs it to always return MM/DD/YYYY for this field. Note extraction-compare's loose-match normalizer only handles a single date value, not a comma-joined list, so BDA will show as a hard miss here rather than a loose match, unlike the single-value date fields.
notes.transaction_details.withdrawals: Not extracted by either method for this document, despite being a defined schema field.
